FVTK.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
FVTK.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log Foundry VTT Toolkit activity to the browser console.
FVTK.Import.Title: Import from NotebookLM
FVTK.Import.Instructions: Paste one or more ##ENTRY blocks copied from NotebookLM. Journal, location, thread and scene entries become journals; the preview shows what every other type becomes, or that it is not supported yet.
FVTK.Import.File: …or choose a file exported from NotebookLM (.md or .txt):
FVTK.Import.ImageFolder: Scene image folder (optional). Locations and scenes whose name matches an image file, e.g. the-overlook.jpg, also become Foundry scenes:
FVTK.Import.ImageFolderError: Could not read the scene image folder {folder}; importing without scenes.
FVTK.Import.Overwrite: Replace journals, items, NPCs, scenes and playlists that already exist with the same name (picked YouTube tracks are kept)
FVTK.Import.Done: NotebookLM import: {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped, {scenes} scenes created or updated, {relinked} earlier journals re-linked.
FVTK.Import.GMOnly: Only a GM can import from NotebookLM.
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeKey.Name: YouTube Data API key (GM)
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeKey.Hint: Used by the YouTube track picker to search. Stored only in this browser, never sent to players. Create one in Google Cloud Console (YouTube Data API v3) and restrict it to this site.
FVTK.YouTube.ClosedNotice: YouTube music is off on your screen until the next track starts.
FVTK.YouTube.PlayError: YouTube could not play "{title}" (error {code}); the owner may not allow embedding. Pick another track.
FVTK.YouTube.NoKey: Add your YouTube Data API key in Configure Settings → Foundry VTT Toolkit to search. You can still paste links.
FVTK.YouTube.QuotaHint: Each search uses about 101 of the API key's 10,000 free daily units.
FVTK.YouTube.NoResults: No embeddable videos found; try another search.
FVTK.YouTube.BadLink: That is not a YouTube video link.
FVTK.YouTube.NoPlaylists: Create or import a playlist first.
